snippet.title: Bloodletter - A strategic deck-builder where cunning and craft are needed to vanquish evil!
snippet.description:
Play the demo on itch.io https://aldamami-games.itch.io/bloodletter?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt Bloodletter is a strategic deck-builder where cunning and craft are needed to vanquish evil. A deck-builder most strategic, its roots lie entwined with the arcane art of tarot, remedies of the flesh, and the surrounding superstitions.

Evil entities have crept into the hearts of the common folk, who teeter upon the brink of madness and death. Only thy bathhouse stands as a bastion against the creeping corruption. 

Will thy dubious methods offer them salvation?
